specialtyId.description: Identifier of the global specialty this tenant specialty is based on. Required and must reference an existing global specialty; a missing or blank value is rejected with 400 before any other validation runs.

data.description: Tenant-specific metadata for this specialty (e.g. display name, description, change reason). Validated against the TenantSpecialty JSON Schema; on PUT this value fully replaces any previously stored data — fields omitted here are cleared, not preserved.
